title: Labels on travel-size wash products

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: A reminder about the travel shelf. The large card above it shows the price of a sealed travel kit. A shelf tag directly beneath a bottle shows that bottle’s price. We sell the kit as well as the individual items, so the same bottle can appear in both places. If a shopper wants only the shampoo, scan the bottle, not the kit’s sleeve. If the bottle’s shelf tag is missing, use its barcode at the price checker before promising any price.
turns.zh: 提醒一下旅行用品架的標價方式。架子上方的大卡寫的是一整組封裝旅行組的價格；瓶子正下方的小標寫的是那瓶的單價。我們賣整組，也單賣組內各品項，所以同款瓶裝品可能出現在兩處。如果顧客只要洗髮精，請掃瓶身，不要掃旅行組外面的套紙。瓶下的小標若不見，請先用瓶身條碼在查價機確認，再告訴顧客價格。
